messages:
marta: Quick sync: kicking off a field test for the LangChain pipeline adapter + AWS Marketplace listing with VectorCompute (HW partner). Need eng + partner eng + marketing. :rocket:

devon: On it. I'll own partner-eng coordination. Who's the runtime contact for perf targets?

sarah: sarah (eng-runtime): I'll take perf targets. Need baseline qps/latency from VectorCompute and a small prompt set. Can someone share?

kai: kai (partner-eng, VectorCompute): We have baseline infra numbers — attaching in a sec. Also we can provide 2 x A100 nodes for the lab.

marta: Thanks. Target: 200 QPS @ 95ms p50 for short prompts, 50 QPS @ 300ms for chat flows. Can we validate with continuous batching enabled?

sarah: Yes, want to test batching levels 8/16 and quantized v1. I'll set up a smoke harness.

alex-r: alex-r (product): Marketing wants a joint demo for Compute Summit on June 12. If field test passes, they'd like a 2-min demo and blog co-post.

helen-marketing: helen-marketing: noted. I'll draft co-branding guidelines and coordinate announcement timing. Any embargo windows from VectorCompute?

kai: kai: No embargo, but we prefer a joint press release 24h before demo. Also need logo approval.

marta: OK. Two main tracks: 1) Tech field test (eng runtime + partner-eng), 2) Marketplace listing (legal + marketplace ops + marketing). Assign owners.

devon: I'll own track 1 with sarah and kai. alex-r, can you take track 2 with helen?

alex-r: Happy to. I'll loop in legal for AWS listing contract and marketplace artifacts.

helen-marketing: Checklist draft:
```
- Joint logo asset
- One-liner + 2-paragraph partner quote
- Demo video (2 min)
- Marketplace product icon + screenshots (1024x1024)
- Listing category & pricing tier
```
I'll share a template.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New channel created: #partner-fieldtest-2765432101

devon: @sarah can you draft a perf harness by EOD tomorrow? I can get access to the A100 nodes.

sarah: Yep. Will sketch harness and a small prompt set (20 prompts) and post results to the channel.

kai: I'll provision nodes and a sample dataset (sanitized). Also will share a quick runbook for reproducing.

marta: Risk notes: legal review may take 5-7 business days. If we miss AWS marketplace window, fallback is a partner spotlight blog only.

alex-r: Scheduling: field test week of May 19 -> run demos week of May 26 -> marketing pre-announce June 5 -> demo June 12. Thoughts?

helen-marketing: Looks tight but doable. I'll prepare embargo calendar and support assets.

devon: OK — next steps: sarah/kai run perf harness, alex/legal start marketplace intake, helen draft co-branding. Check-in Friday 10am PT?

marta: Check-in Friday 10am PT works. Thanks all :thumbsup:
